rules.rule: If delivery is delayed beyond estimated date by more than 3 days, customer is eligible for shipping fee refund or a goodwill coupon.
conditions: Delay must exceed 3 days from promised ETA
Customer must contact support to claim
exceptions: Force majeure events (natural disasters, strikes) excluded

rules.rule: If first delivery attempt fails, two more attempts are made on the next two business days before the order is returned to seller.
conditions: Customer must be reachable on registered phone number
exceptions: After 3 failed attempts, order is cancelled and refund is initiated

rules.rule: Delivery address can be changed only before the order is shipped. Once shipped, address change is not possible.
conditions: Change must be in same pincode region for some sellers
exceptions: Address cannot be changed once shipped

rules.rule: Lost shipments are eligible for full refund or replacement after 5 business days of investigation by the logistics team.
conditions: Customer must report non-delivery after ETA passes
exceptions: Shipments marked delivered but not received require additional verification

rules.rule: High-value lost shipments (order value above 40000 INR or approximately 500 USD) follow an expedited 3-day investigation with mandatory carrier escalation, GPS verification, fraud risk check, and manager approval for refunds above 100000 INR. Customers receive priority handling and resolution within 5 business days.
conditions: Order value must exceed 40000 INR (~500 USD)
Customer must report non-receipt within 48 hours of expected delivery
Customer affidavit and government-issued ID required
Fraud risk score must clear before refund is released
exceptions: Refunds above 100000 INR require manager approval
Police report recommended for amounts above 100000 INR
Repeat-claim accounts may require additional verification

rules.rule: When tracking marks a shipment as delivered but the customer reports non-receipt, a 4-day investigation is launched including GPS coordinate verification, proof-of-delivery (POD) review, photo evidence check (if available from carrier), and inquiries with neighbors, security, or building reception. Refund or signed redelivery is offered based on investigation outcome.
conditions: Customer must report non-receipt within 7 days of marked delivery
Customer must confirm delivery address details
exceptions: If signed POD exists with matching GPS coordinates, customer must file affidavit
